    StartersCurly's brisket sliders with slawFoil-baked brisket shredded in barbecue sauce on slider buns, with slawHow to make it1kg beef brisket1 tbsp smoked paprika2 tbsp brown sugar1 tsp garlic powder150ml barbecue sauce1/4 cabbage, shredded2 tbsp mayonnaise1 tbsp apple cider vinegar12 slider bunssalt, to tasteRub the brisket with paprika, brown sugar, garlic powder and salt.Wrap tightly in foil.Bake at 150°C until it pulls apart.Shred with two forks and stir through the barbecue sauce and juices.Toss the cabbage with mayonnaise and vinegar.Fill the buns with brisket and slaw.New York bagel bitesMini bagels with cream cheese, smoked salmon, capers and dillHow to make it8 mini bagels150g cream cheese150g smoked salmon2 tbsp capers1/2 red onion1 small bunch dillSplit and toast the bagels.Spread with cream cheese.Top with smoked salmon, capers, thin red onion and dill.Pan cornbread with honey butterThe first night out on the driveHow to make itAs written, serves 4Buttermilk cornbread baked in a smoking hot cast iron pan until crusty at the edges, cut into wedges and served warm with whipped honey butter.Put a cast iron pan with 20g butter in the oven and heat to 220°C.Mix 150g cornmeal, 100g plain flour, 2 tsp baking powder, 1 tbsp sugar and a pinch of salt.Whisk 250ml buttermilk, 1 egg and 60g melted butter, then stir briefly into the dry mix.Pour into the hot pan and bake 20 minutes until golden.Beat 80g soft butter with 2 tbsp honey and serve with the warm wedges.Fry bread with honey and chilliCurly's one thing? dried chillies2 tsp ground cumin3 cloves of garlic400g can crushed tomatoes400g can kidney beans, drained1 packet cornbread mixSoak the dried chillies in hot water and blitz.Brown the beef in batches.Add the chillies, cumin, garlic, tomatoes and kidney beans.Braise until the beef is tender.Bake the cornbread in a pan and serve with the chilli.Cast iron rib eye with ranch beansSupper on the cattle driveHow to make itAs written, serves 4Rib eye seasoned heavily and seared in cast iron, rested, with beans simmered with bacon and molasses and potatoes fried crisp in the steak pan with onion.Fry 150g diced bacon and an onion, add 2 drained cans of cannellini beans, 3 tbsp molasses, 2 tbsp tomato paste, 1 tbsp mustard and 300ml water and simmer 45 minutes.Parboil 800g potatoes in chunks for 8 minutes.Season 4 rib eye steaks heavily and sear in a smoking cast iron pan for 4 minutes a side, then rest.Fry the potatoes and a sliced onion in the steak fat until crisp.SweetsNorman's
